description: This file contains unit tests for version parsing and comparison functions related to the OpenClaw project. The tests verify the correctness of version parsing, comparisons between versions, and logic determining whether versions belong to the same stable family or if a warning should be issued for touched versions.

methods.name: parseOpenClawVersion
methods.description: Parses version strings into structured version objects, handling stable, correction, and prerelease (beta) formats, or returns null for invalid strings.

methods.name: compareOpenClawVersions
methods.description: Compares two version strings to determine their ordering, considering stable, correction, and beta versions.

methods.name: isSameOpenClawStableFamily
methods.description: Determines whether two version strings belong to the same stable version family, ignoring correction increments.

methods.name: shouldWarnOnTouchedVersion
methods.description: Decides if a warning should be issued when a version is touched or updated, based on version age and stability considerations.
